k2_06_reference_attribution.package_history: linux-cachyos-bore 7.3.0-2 was installed on 2026-10-30, before the 2026-11-14 incident; no persistent uni_mes or sched_policy override was found in the readable modprobe/boot configuration.
k2_06_reference_attribution.parameter_correction: uni_mes is not itself KFD shared_resources.enable_mes. In reference amdgpu_discovery_set_mes_ip_blocks, enable_mes is set only for GC11/GC12. uni_mes is consulted only in the GC12 cases to set enable_uni_mes.
k2_06_reference_attribution.kfd_handoff: amdgpu_amdkfd_device_init copies adev->enable_mes to KFD shared_resources.enable_mes.
k2_06_reference_attribution.reference_selected_branch: For GC8 under this reference source: shared_resources.enable_mes=false; evict_process_queues_cpsch reaches execute_queues_cpsch then unmap_queues_cpsch.
k2_06_reference_attribution.journal_alignment: The retained 'unsuccessful queues preemption' text is emitted by unmap_queues_cpsch after amdkfd_fence_wait_timeout returns nonzero.
k2_06_reference_attribution.allowed_conclusion: The prior MES/remove_hw_queue hypothesis is eliminated for the v7.3 Polaris reference path. The exact CachyOS incident branch and internal errno remain unobserved, because no exact source match, trace, vmcore or devcoredump exists.

retained_pre_review_source.behavior: The manual gfx803 patch declines only warptopk; it leaves normal multi-block versus single-block selection enabled.

source_route.warptopk: eliminated by the retained manual patch and independently inapplicable to a 151936-element slice under the source threshold
source_route.mbtopk: selected by should_use_multiblock for both cases: <=20 slices and >=20000 elements, or 21-40 slices and >=10000 elements
source_route.sbtopk: not selected by that retained source route

binary.provenance_limit: The retained source artifact and this ELF have no demonstrated byte-for-byte build linkage; symbols establish inclusion, not incident-time dispatch.
